text.arabic_uthmani: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ فَأَخْرَجْنَا بِهِۦ ثَمَرَٰتٍۢ مُّخْتَلِفًا أَلْوَٰنُهَا ۚ وَمِنَ ٱلْجِبَالِ جُدَدٌۢ بِيضٌۭ وَحُمْرٌۭ مُّخْتَلِفٌ أَلْوَٰنُهَا وَغَرَابِيبُ سُودٌۭ

words.gloss_range: interrogative-negating opening particle that governs the seeing verb and frames the whole scene as demanded recognition

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: jussive seeing verb governed by the opening particle

words.prose: {{ar:أَلَمْ}} ({{tr:a-lam}}) opens by fusing question and negation before the seeing verb arrives. The particle does not simply deny; it presses the hearer toward acknowledgment, so the whole scene of sky, water, fruits, and mountains is read under accountable recognition.

topics.headline: negated recognition question
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah opens as demanded acknowledgment, not as a neutral question about scenery.
topics.reason: The opening particle combines interrogation with jussive negation and governs the following seeing verb.

topics.headline: whole-scene rhetorical scope
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that sky, water, fruits, and mountains all arrive under the same recognition challenge.
topics.reason: The particle pair scopes over the perception clause and its embedded proposition, while the boundary row keeps the listener in a recognition posture after 35:26.

words.gloss_range: jussive second-person perception verb taking an asserted proposition as its content, so seeing becomes accountable recognition
words.root_gloss_range: seeing, perceiving, and forming a considered view; local jussive frame selects demanded recognition through visible evidence

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: assertive complement particle introducing the proposition seen

words.prose: {{ar:تَرَ}} ({{tr:tara}}) is pulled into the opening challenge as a jussive, clipped perception verb. It takes the asserted clause as its content, so the requested seeing is a judgment-bearing recognition of divine action and visible evidence; the same sight thread later turns polemical in 35:40.

topics.headline: jussive proposition-seeing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb asks the hearer to perceive an asserted event, not merely look at an object.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence show a jussive perception verb governed by the opening particle and taking the following asserted clause as content.

topics.headline: sight with judgment pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that visible colors function as evidence for considered recognition, while the local verb remains ordinary seeing in the opening challenge.
topics.reason: The root range supports sight and considered view, but local grammar selects the second-person seeing summons rather than an independent opinion formula.

topics.headline: surah sight thread
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 35:27 begins a sight-based argument that later reappears as polemical testing in 35:40.
topics.reason: The rows explicitly connect the opening perception verb with divine agency, descent language, and the later same-surah sight recurrence in 35:40.

words.gloss_range: assertive complement particle that turns the visible scene into a proposition about divine agency

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: accusative proper noun governed by the particle

words.prose: {{ar:أَنَّ}} ({{tr:anna}}) prevents the scene from staying as loose observation. It embeds the following material as asserted content under the seeing verb, making the descent and its agent part of what must be recognized as true.

topics.headline: asserted content clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the scene is framed as a claim to be acknowledged, not as raw sensory material.
topics.reason: The particle introduces an annulling content clause, governs the divine name, and embeds the descent as what the seeing verb must recognize.

words.gloss_range: proper divine name as accusative subject of the embedded proposition and named agent of rain descent
words.root_gloss_range: divine name field with worship, refuge, and orientation pressures; local proper noun fixes the named agent inside the perceived proposition

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: descent verb whose agent is the divine name
first-person plural bringing-out verb continuing the agency line

words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهَ}} ({{tr:Allāha}}) stands inside that proposition as the named agent before the rain process is described. The proper name blocks an anonymous-nature reading, while the worship-orientation pressure of the name redirects recognition toward the one agent whose singular naming continues into the later first-person plural action. The weather-agency parallel in 24:43 supports this directed rather than anonymous reading.

topics.headline: named agent before process
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that agency is named before rainfall is described, so the water cycle is not left anonymous.
topics.reason: The divine name is the accusative subject inside the asserted proposition and precedes the descent verb as its semantic agent.

topics.headline: worship-orientation pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that recognition is redirected toward the named divine agent, while the local form remains the proper name rather than a common-noun derivation argument.
topics.reason: The derivational and worship-refuge pressures survive as orientation, but local grammar fixes a proper name in the embedded proposition.

topics.headline: agency across verbs
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices one sustained divine agency across the singular named descent and the later first-person plural bringing-out.
topics.reason: The rows connect the divine name with sky/descent fields and with the later first-person plural verb, without creating separate agents.

words.gloss_range: completed Form IV caused descent of rainwater from the sky as directed provision
words.root_gloss_range: descent, alighting, delivery, provision, and revelation-like sending; local object and source select caused rain-descent as provision

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: water object selecting physical rain in this descent frame
sky source phrase for the descent

words.prose: {{ar:أَنزَلَ}} ({{tr:anzala}}) presents rain as caused descent from above, with the water object and sky source narrowing the broad descent range to physical rain. The word still carries arrival and provision pressure: the sent-down input becomes the upstream cause that the next beat turns into visible outputs. A related rain-to-growth sequence appears in 39:21, while here the result is specialized through color diversity.

topics.headline: caused rain descent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the rain as a caused delivery from above, not as water merely falling.
topics.reason: The Form IV perfect takes water as direct object and the sky phrase as source, licensing caused directed descent.

topics.headline: provision narrowed to rain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the arrival-provision feel of descent, while the water object and sky source keep the local sense to physical rain.
topics.reason: The broader descent range includes revelation and prepared arrival, but this construction selects rainwater as the object.

topics.headline: upstream cause before output
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices descent as the upstream beat that will be transformed into plural visible outputs.
topics.reason: The row set links descent-water-output sequencing, including the 39:21 parallel, and the local clause order places descent before extraction.

words.gloss_range: source preposition marking the sky as origin of the water rather than a partitive set

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: governed sky noun marking the source of descent
later matching preposition with domain or partitive force

words.prose: {{ar:مِنَ}} ({{tr:mina}}) marks the sky as the source of the water and keeps that source relation attached to the descent verb. Its first use matters because the later matching preposition shifts force, from water from the sky to bands among mountains.

topics.headline: sky as source
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the water's upper origin before any earthly effects appear.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the sky noun and attaches to the descent verb as a source phrase.

topics.headline: source-to-domain contrast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the repeated particle later shifts from source of water to domain of mountain bands.
topics.reason: The first occurrence marks origin for descent, while the second occurrence heads the mountain-domain phrase.

words.gloss_range: definite upper source-domain from which rainwater descends, contrasted with the indefinite water object
words.root_gloss_range: height, elevation, and upper-domain language; local genitive noun names the known upper source of rain

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: later elevated domain where color is displayed

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلسَّمَآءِ}} ({{tr:al-samāʾi}}) names a definite upper source-domain. Its elevation pressure gives the ayah a vertical axis: water descends from height, and later the mountains resume height as a surface where color becomes visible evidence.

topics.headline: definite upper source
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a known elevated source contrasted with an unbounded water input.
topics.reason: The noun is definite and genitive after the source preposition, while the following water object is indefinite.

topics.headline: vertical axis of evidence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah starting with height as source and later returning to height in the mountains.
topics.reason: The height root pressure and sky-water-descent field support a vertical source axis that the mountain clause resumes.

words.gloss_range: indefinite rainwater object that becomes the single medium for multiple visible outputs
words.root_gloss_range: water as elemental substance, with debated root analysis; local source phrase selects rainwater as productive input

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: instrumental pronoun that resumes the water

words.prose: {{ar:مَاءً}} ({{tr:māʾan}}) is an indefinite single input before the ayah multiplies outputs into fruits and colors. The sky phrase narrows it to rainwater, and the later pronoun carries this same water forward as the medium of production rather than leaving it behind as a completed object.

topics.headline: indefinite single input
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices one unbounded water substance before many fruits and colors appear.
topics.reason: The noun is an indefinite accusative object of descent, and its singular form stands before plural outputs.

topics.headline: rainwater as medium
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices water as the rain input that later mediates fruit emergence, while the sky phrase blocks a generic-fluid reading.
topics.reason: The source phrase selects rainfall, and the later pronoun makes that same water the instrument of production.

topics.headline: resumed into extraction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the water is carried forward into the next clause rather than left behind as a completed object.
topics.reason: The pronoun in the instrumental phrase refers back to this water object.

words.gloss_range: close-result connector joining descent to extraction and carrying the turn into first-person plural action

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: following verb joined by the close-result connector

words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) is the close hinge from descent to extraction. It marks fruit emergence as consequence, and because it is attached to the bringing-out verb, it also hosts the shift from third-person report to first-person plural action.

topics.headline: close result hinge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the descent-to-output transition compressed into a close consequence, not a loose addition.
topics.reason: The prefixed connector marks sequence/result between the descent clause and the bringing-out clause.

topics.headline: host of person shift
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same hinge also carries the move from third-person report to first-person plural action.
topics.reason: The connector is attached to the extraction verb where the discourse person changes.

words.gloss_range: first-person plural Form IV bringing-out, causing hidden produce to become visible through water
words.root_gloss_range: going out, emergence, disclosure, and caused bringing-forth; local Form IV selects divine production of visible fruits through water

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: instrument phrase marking water as means
direct object produced by the verb

words.prose: {{ar:أَخْرَجْنَا}} ({{tr:akhrajnā}}) makes the productive act agentive: fruits are brought out through the water, not merely allowed to appear. The root's hidden-to-visible pressure fits the movement from unseen growth to colored produce, while the first-person plural renews divine immediacy mid-process. The water-to-vegetation pattern is visible in 6:99, and the same emergence root threads through 35:12 and 35:37.

topics.headline: caused production frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices fruits being caused out through a means, not simply appearing by themselves.
topics.reason: The Form IV perfect has first-person plural subject, a direct fruit object, and an instrumental water phrase.

topics.headline: hidden-to-visible disclosure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices growth as hidden process becoming visible produce and color.
topics.reason: The root image of going out fits the local object and the ayah's movement toward visible fruits.

topics.headline: water-fruit production pattern
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices this bringing-out as part of a recurring water-to-produce pattern, including 6:99, while 35:27 turns it toward color evidence.
topics.reason: The rows connect bringing-out with water and fruit roots and name same-surah and 6:99 parallels.

topics.headline: renewed divine presence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices divine agency refreshed at the moment the hidden cause becomes visible output.
topics.reason: The shift from named third-person descent to first-person plural production is explicit in the local verbs and follows the prior boundary from judgment to providential ordering.

words.gloss_range: instrumental preposition plus pronoun that resumes the water and makes it the means of fruit emergence

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: antecedent of the attached pronoun

words.prose: {{ar:بِهِ}} ({{tr:bihi}}) compresses instrument and anaphora into one word. The pronoun resumes the water and the preposition makes it the means or enabling cause, binding the descent clause tightly to the fruit-emergence clause.

topics.headline: water as instrument
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the descended water converted grammatically into the means of producing fruits.
topics.reason: The preposition plus pronoun points back to the water and attaches as the instrumental phrase of the bringing-out verb.

topics.headline: cross-clause binding
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the descent clause and extraction clause held together by one pronominal link.
topics.reason: The attached pronoun prevents the water from remaining only an earlier object and carries it into the result clause.

words.gloss_range: indefinite plural fruits as concrete produced yield, prepared for color-difference description
words.root_gloss_range: fruit, yield, and result; local object frame selects concrete produced fruits as visible yield

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: following participle describing the fruits as differing

words.prose: {{ar:ثَمَرَاتٍ}} ({{tr:thamarātin}}) is the first visible produced field after the water. As an indefinite plural object, it opens room for many kinds of fruit, and the following participle turns that abundance into color-differentiated evidence rather than mere multiplication.

topics.headline: plural produced object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the first visible output as an open plural category ready for differentiated colors.
topics.reason: The noun is an indefinite plural accusative direct object and provides the referent for the following differing-state participle.

topics.headline: yield as visible produce
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices yield language grounded in concrete fruit rather than abstract benefit.
topics.reason: The root can cover yield or result, but the water-and-extraction frame selects concrete produce.

topics.headline: first display field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices living produce as the first surface where one water input becomes visible diversity.
topics.reason: The sequence moves from water to fruits before mountains, and the repeated color-difference formula later extends the same logic.

words.gloss_range: accusative Form VIII participle describing produced fruits as mutually differing in their colors
words.root_gloss_range: succession, alternation, opposition, and divergence; local color frame selects ordered variation rather than conflict

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: colors that explain the fruit difference
matching mountain participle with changed case

words.prose: {{ar:مُّخْتَلِفًا}} ({{tr:mukhtalifan}}) makes the fruits come forth in a state of difference. The Form VIII participle gives the set reciprocal divergence, while the color frame keeps that divergence ordered; its near-repeat with the mountain phrase and its extension into human and animal colors in 35:28 make the difference-color formula a structural refrain.

topics.headline: accusative differing state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices difference as an active state of the produced fruits, not merely an added color label.
topics.reason: The participle is accusative after the fruit object and works as a state or adjective-like modifier explained by the following colors.

topics.headline: ordered reciprocal divergence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices fruits diverging from one another within one produced set, while the color frame keeps difference ordered rather than conflictual.
topics.reason: The root range includes opposition and succession, but local colors and Form VIII select reciprocal visual variation.

topics.headline: difference-color refrain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a repeated difference-color formula that binds fruits to mountains and then continues into living beings in 35:28.
topics.reason: The same participle-color pairing recurs within 35:27 and is echoed near-verbatim in 35:28.

words.gloss_range: plural color noun with suffix referring to fruits, making visible properties the locus of difference
words.root_gloss_range: color, hue, and kind/category; local phrase makes fruit colors the subject of visible difference

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: participle for which colors are the locus of difference
identical color phrase with a mountain-band antecedent

words.prose: {{ar:أَلْوَانُهَا}} ({{tr:alwānuhā}}) names the colors as what actually differ, with the suffix tying them to the fruits. The hue-to-kind range lets visible color imply classification, and the exact color noun becomes the shared property-level evidence surface that returns with the mountain bands. Color variation also belongs to a wider sign field in 16:13, 16:69, 30:22, and 39:21.

topics.headline: fruit colors as subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the grammar shifts attention from fruits as objects to their colors as what actually differs.
topics.reason: The suffix ties colors to fruits, and the nominative noun names the subject or locus of the participle's difference.

topics.headline: color as classification
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices color functioning as visible classification, while the local phrase still names fruit colors rather than every possible kind.
topics.reason: The word can range from hue to kind, and the fruit context lets visible color imply differentiation without leaving the local color phrase.

topics.headline: color refrain as sign field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the exact color noun as the shared evidence surface across fruits and mountains, with Quranic sign parallels such as 16:13, 16:69, 30:22, and 39:21.
topics.reason: The rows point to uncommon color-root recurrence, exact phrase repetition, and named sign-context parallels.

words.gloss_range: coordinating particle that adds the mountain domain as parallel evidence without making it a chronological result

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: following preposition opening the mountain domain

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) adds mountains as a parallel evidence field rather than as another consequence of the water clause. The ayah shifts domains through a coordinated, verbless expansion without rebuilding the whole verbal sequence.

topics.headline: parallel domain coordination
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices mountains added as parallel testimony, not as a chronological product of the water clause.
topics.reason: The coordinating particle opens the mountain phrase with continuity but without the close-result force of the earlier connector.

topics.headline: elliptical expansion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a domain shift without the ayah rebuilding the full verbal frame.
topics.reason: The conjunction introduces a verbless mountain clause coordinated with the fruit evidence.

words.gloss_range: fronted domain/partitive preposition marking bands among mountains and shifting from sky-source relation to mountain-location relation

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: delayed subject inside the fronted mountain-domain phrase
earlier source preposition contrasted with this domain use

words.prose: {{ar:مِنَ}} ({{tr:mina}}) fronts the mountain domain before the bands appear. Unlike the first source-preposition, this occurrence marks inclusion or location among mountains, so the same particle maps a new spatial relation.

topics.headline: fronted mountain domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the field of observation first and only then the bands within it.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the mountain noun and fronts the domain before the delayed nominative subject.

topics.headline: second preposition shift
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same particle reused with a new spatial relation: no longer source from above, but inclusion among mountains.
topics.reason: The local mountain clause licenses partitive or domain-locative force, contrasting with the first source phrase.

words.gloss_range: definite plural mountain domain, fixed and elevated, within which colored bands are observed
words.root_gloss_range: mountain, formed mass, and created constitution; local plural domain names fixed elevations that display internal variety

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: bands observed within the mountain domain
earlier elevated source-domain paired with mountains

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْجِبَالِ}} ({{tr:al-jibāli}}) moves the reader into a broad, definite domain of formed elevations. Fixed stone becomes the second evidence field: not organic growth, but high geological surfaces displaying internal color variety.

topics.headline: broad formed domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the move from a known broad mountain domain to particular visible bands.
topics.reason: The noun is definite plural genitive after the preposition, while the bands are indefinite within that domain.

topics.headline: fixed stone displaying variety
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices fixed created mass becoming a display surface for internal color variation.
topics.reason: The mountain root field supports formed elevation and constitution, while the local clause selects mountains as the geological domain.

topics.headline: paired elevated witnesses
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices sky and mountains as two elevated domains with different roles: one sends water, the other displays color.
topics.reason: The rows explicitly pair the sky source with the mountain display domain.

words.gloss_range: indefinite plural mountain bands or streaks, delayed as subject after the fronted domain phrase
words.root_gloss_range: newness, track, cut, path, and band; local mountain clause selects visible bands or streaks across stone

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: first color adjective modifying the bands
second named color adjective modifying the bands

words.prose: {{ar:جُدَدٌ}} ({{tr:judadun}}) is the delayed subject inside the mountain clause, the visible bands that the colors qualify. Its track, cut, and newness pressures make the mountain surface look like readable streaks across ancient stone, with variant vowels and repeated stops reinforcing the segmented feel.

topics.headline: delayed band subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the bands emerging grammatically inside the mountain domain and carrying the following color adjectives.
topics.reason: The word is the delayed nominative subject after the fronted phrase and supplies the noun qualified by white and red.

topics.headline: marked track-band image
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices mountain color as readable bands, streaks, or exposed tracks across stone, while local context keeps the sense geological.
topics.reason: The root and rarity evidence support tracks, cuts, and banding; the mountain clause selects visible strata rather than abstract newness alone.

topics.headline: variant and sound texture
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that variant vowels and repeated stop sounds keep the band sense stable while making the surface feel segmented.
topics.reason: The variant rows preserve the consonantal band frame, and the sound rows match the segmented track image.

words.gloss_range: nominative white color adjective marking the first bright pole of the mountain-band palette
words.root_gloss_range: whiteness, brightness, and pale gleam; local mountain context selects bright stone bands without moral face-valence

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: band noun qualified by the white adjective
final black adjective answering the white pole

words.prose: {{ar:بِيضٌ}} ({{tr:bīḍun}}) begins the explicit mountain palette by attaching whiteness to the bands. The brightness field reads materially in stone, not morally on faces, and it opens the visual arc that the final black adjective will close.

topics.headline: white bands, not whole mountains
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices whiteness attached to the bands after the band noun, beginning the explicit mountain palette.
topics.reason: The nominative color adjective agrees with the band noun rather than describing mountains indiscriminately.

topics.headline: bright material pole
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a gleaming bright pole in stone, while moral face-whiteness is not imported into the local geology.
topics.reason: The root field supports brightness, but the local mountain-band context selects material color.

topics.headline: white-to-black arc
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the first explicit hue anticipating the final black endpoint of the mountain sequence.
topics.reason: The rows explicitly connect the opening white adjective with the final black adjective.

words.gloss_range: coordinating particle adding red to white as a peer color before the broader variation phrase

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: red adjective coordinated with the preceding white adjective

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) adds red beside white without hierarchy. By placing another named hue before the general difference-color phrase, the conjunction lets concrete examples lead into broader variation.

topics.headline: red coordinated with white
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices red added as a peer hue, without hierarchy or causation.
topics.reason: The coordinating particle links the red adjective to the white adjective in the same mountain-band list.

topics.headline: named hues before generalization
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices concrete color examples arriving before the broader statement that their colors differ.
topics.reason: The conjunction widens the palette before the following difference-color phrase generalizes the variation.

words.gloss_range: nominative red color adjective naming a warm middle hue in the mountain-band palette
words.root_gloss_range: redness across bodies, animals, earth, and objects; local mountain context selects reddish stone or mineral coloration

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: white adjective before the red middle term
intensified black phrase after the red middle term

words.prose: {{ar:حُمْرٌ}} ({{tr:ḥumrun}}) gives the mountain palette a warm middle term. In this setting, redness narrows naturally to reddish rock or mineral stain, filling the space between bright white bands and the intensified black close.

topics.headline: red in the same band frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices red as a named mountain-band hue that prepares the later general variety phrase.
topics.reason: The adjective is coordinated with the white adjective and shares the same mountain-band predicate frame.

topics.headline: mineral red middle
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices reddish stone or mineral stain filling the palette between white brightness and intensified blackness.
topics.reason: The broader red field includes bodies and objects, but mountain context selects material geology and a middle hue.

words.gloss_range: nominative Form VIII participle making the mountain-band colors mutually varied while echoing the fruit phrase
words.root_gloss_range: succession, alternation, opposition, and divergence; local mountain color frame selects ordered geological variation

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: colors that explain the mountain difference
earlier fruit participle with accusative case

words.prose: {{ar:مُّخْتَلِفٌ}} ({{tr:mukhtalifun}}) repeats the difference logic in the mountain clause with nominative case. The same Form VIII pressure now makes strata and colors mutually varied within stone, bridging fruit diversity and geological banding without making the two clauses grammatically identical.

topics.headline: nominative mountain difference
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices mountain color variation as a counterpart to fruit variation, but fitted to a different clause structure.
topics.reason: The participle is nominative in the mountain clause and repeats the Form VIII divergence pattern from the fruit clause.

topics.headline: geological ordered variety
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices strata and colors as ordered alternation within stone, while the local phrase keeps the focus on visible colors and kinds.
topics.reason: The root pressure of succession and divergence fits layered mountain bands, with colors as the explicit site of difference.

topics.headline: fruit-to-mountain bridge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the repeated formula carrying the argument from organic growth to geology.
topics.reason: The same difference-color pair returns after the domain shift and completes the intra-ayah refrain.

words.gloss_range: plural color noun with suffix now referring to bands, preserving the phrase while changing its antecedent
words.root_gloss_range: color, hue, and kind/category; local phrase makes mountain-band colors the subject of visible difference

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: most direct antecedent of the suffix

Color again becomes the subject of difference, now as geological hue and material classification, so the fruit-mountain parallel rests on visible properties rather than on the objects themselves.

topics.headline: same form, shifted antecedent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the identical color phrase now routed to mountain bands rather than fruits.
topics.reason: The feminine suffix most directly resumes the band noun while preserving the same surface form as the fruit phrase.

topics.headline: geological color classification
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices mountain color as a clue to material class, while local grammar still names the bands' colors.
topics.reason: The color/kind range survives because the mountain setting lets hue imply composition without replacing the explicit color phrase.

topics.headline: property-level parallel
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the fruit-mountain parallel rests on shared visible properties, not merely on a list of different objects.
topics.reason: The repeated color noun and difference-color pair make color the ayah's shared evidence surface, with 30:22 as a named sign parallel.

words.gloss_range: final coordinating particle that keeps the intense-black phrase inside the mountain palette and moves the list to closure

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: final intensified black phrase coordinated into the list

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) keeps the final intense-black phrase inside the same coordinated palette. After white, red, and varied colors, the connector moves the list into its darkest terminal member.

topics.headline: final black coordination
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the intense-black phrase kept inside the same mountain palette rather than detached as a new domain.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Words 5-13 form a descent-to-emergence sequence, while words 12-13 and 19-20 repeat the difference-and-color construction.
baseline_models.mechanism: A single delivered medium enables concealed growth to emerge as plural mature yields. The repeated divergence construction then aligns organic products with mineral appearances without requiring the same immediate cause for both domains.

activation_trace.role: Delivery from above makes descent the common initiating transfer.
Ordinary water supplies the shared material medium rather than a merely figurative connector.
Bringing a hidden thing into disclosure turns watering into visible production.
Ripened fruit identifies the outputs as completed yields of the process.
Taking distinct paths gives the repeated difference term a mechanism of divergence, not a loose label.
Kind or type lets visible color register differentiated output classes.

changed_reading.before: Rain produces colorful fruit, and mountains also display several colors.
changed_reading.after: One delivered input issues in plural mature outcomes, and the repeated difference-color construction makes divergence itself the observable result across living and mineral domains.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Words 15-22 move from mountain mass to visible lines and then through white, red, varied, and maximally dark appearances.
baseline_models.mechanism: The mountain is a solid mass whose exposed lines organize hue spatially. White, red, and intensified black therefore describe patterned banding and contrast, not an inventory of detached colored objects.

activation_trace.role: An elevated solid mass supplies the stable material body in which difference appears.
Visible tracks or lines arrange the colors as extended bands through the mountain.
Surface appearance makes hue the legible property shared by fruit and rock.
Literal whiteness establishes one end of the visible rock contrast.
Manifest redness supplies a second, internally variable band family.
Crow-like intensity pushes the final dark band toward an extreme rather than another midpoint.
Blackness opposed to whiteness closes the ordered visual range.

changed_reading.before: The verse names mountains containing white, red, and black material.
changed_reading.after: The verse directs attention to extended, contrasting bands embedded in a solid body, so difference has visible spatial order.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Word 2 opens with a question about seeing, and the rest of the ayah repeatedly stages visible emergence, hue, line, and contrast.
baseline_models.mechanism: Eye perception and reflective judgment cooperate: the ayah does not merely place scenery before the observer but asks the observer to compare common cause, divergent results, and extreme contrasts.

activation_trace.role: Sight by eye or insight makes the visible sequence evidence to be actively apprehended.
Reflective judgment turns observation into comparison and inference.
Disclosure from concealment makes process legible through its outcome.
Visible complexion supplies the comparison surface on which difference can be recognized.
An emphatically dark visual endpoint tests attention to degree as well as category.

changed_reading.before: The opening asks whether the addressee has noticed a natural scene.
changed_reading.after: The opening recruits sight and reflection to compare causal sequence, divergent kinds, patterned surfaces, and degrees of contrast.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The split mapping at word 7, the water at word 8, color acquisition, and the visible mountain lines allow a marking mechanism within the focus ayah.
baseline_models.mechanism: A form-distant mapped branch associates early rain with marking land through growth. Read beside acquired coloration and visible mountain lines, descent becomes a maker of legible surface differences; this is a visual analogy and does not assert that the rain caused the mountain bands.

activation_trace.role: Early rain that leaves a vegetative mark activates descent as visible inscription on land.
Water delivered by pouring supplies the material act that makes the mark productive.
Acquiring a new hue makes transformation visible on the produced surface.
Extended visible lines provide a mineral analogue for marked surfaces.

changed_reading.before: Water feeds growth and the ayah separately reports mountain colors.
changed_reading.after: Descent can be carried as a mark-making event whose organic color traces visually answer the already lined mineral surface.

context_deltas.mechanism: The compact descent-and-emergence clause expands into a controlled pipeline: opening versus holding, sending, wind-driven cloud formation and transport, contact with lifeless land, renewed terrestrial life, and finally resurrection as its declared analogue.

activation_trace.role: Downward delivery is the compressed transfer that the context unfolds.
Visible emergence supplies the endpoint whose intermediate stages become explicit in context.
Water issuing through an opened outlet makes release a controlled first step.
Holding and retaining establishes the live alternative to release.
Sending or letting go turns opened provision into directed movement.
Moving air supplies the carrier that initiates the atmospheric sequence.
Stirring something from its place converts air movement into cloud activation.
The drawn-along cloud is the transported reservoir in the pipeline.
Driving gives the cloud a destination rather than random motion.
Land without active life supplies the blocked initial state to be reversed.
Earth revived through rain and vegetation joins hydrology directly to biological renewal.
Dry growth renewed by rain supplies the material bridge to the stated resurrection analogy.

structural_cues: 35:2 orders opening, holding, and sending as controlled alternatives.
35:9 orders wind, cloud activation, driving, dead land, life, and resurrection; 35:27 compresses descent, instrument, and emergence into one causal clause.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies control verbs and a complete transport-to-revival sequence; I infer that 35:27 compresses that pipeline and places differentiated fruit downstream of revived capacity. A live alternative is that 35:9 serves only as a resurrection analogy, not as an expansion of 35:27's material mechanism.

changed_reading.after: Fruit diversity is the terminal visible yield of a governed release, transport, contact, and revival process, with resurrection retained as the process's declared larger analogue.

context_deltas.mechanism: Seeing is epistemically unstable: a bad act can be beautified and judged good, while blindness, insight, darkness, and light are non-equivalent. The later repetition of color diversity ending in knowledge and awe therefore turns the focus question into a demand for disciplined discrimination rather than visual registration alone.

activation_trace.role: Eye and insight together anchor the focus question in perceptual judgment.
Surface appearance is the evidence that must be read without confusing visibility with truth.
Displayed attractiveness shows how a surface can be made persuasively misleading.
Underlying badness supplies the reality concealed by attractive presentation.
Perceived goodness names the erroneous judgment produced by adornment.
Blindness of insight marks failure to interpret what is available to sight.
Inner discernment supplies the non-equivalent successful mode of seeing.
Illumination makes discriminable form possible and opposes obscurity.
Knowledge as disclosure identifies the cognitive result of correctly read diversity.
Awe-inflected fear gives disciplined perception an affective consequence.

structural_cues: 35:8 explicitly separates what is made to look good from what is bad.
35:19-20 pair non-equivalent perceptual states, and 35:28 places knowledge and awe immediately after repeating the color construction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies deceptive appearance, opposed perceptual capacities, and a knowledge-to-awe conclusion; I infer that the question in 35:27 tests interpretive sight. A live alternative is that its primary force remains straightforward observation of physical signs.

changed_reading.before: Seeing the colors is sufficient recognition of the sign.
changed_reading.after: Visible difference is evidence, but the ayah tests whether sight becomes discriminating knowledge rather than remaining vulnerable to attractive misreading.

context_deltas.mechanism: Two waters are explicitly non-equivalent in taste and composition, yet each yields nourishment and extractable adornment. Difference therefore governs affordance and mode of yield, revising color from a cosmetic endpoint into a visible index of materially consequential variation.

activation_trace.role: Divergent paths anchor the focus variation in more than decorative multiplicity.
Kind or type permits visible color to index differing material classes.
Equality comparison under negation explicitly marks the two source media as non-equivalent.
A large body of water supplies the shared domain within which consequential difference operates.
Palatable sweetness specifies one water's usable material character.
Salinity specifies the contrasting water's material character.
Extraction brings a concealed yield out of each unlike medium.
Adornment demonstrates that a medium's yield can be visible and valuable without being food.

structural_cues: 35:12 first denies equivalence, then repeats that usable products come from each water.
35:27 similarly places organic yield and mineral display within one comparison while retaining their material difference.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies unlike waters with different properties and products from both; I infer that focus colors can index underlying affordances and compositions. A live alternative is that 35:27 intends hue alone and does not invite inference from appearance to material function.

changed_reading.before: Different colors are an aesthetic variety laid over otherwise comparable things.
changed_reading.after: Visible variety can signal non-equivalent material conditions and distinct affordances, even when every domain still yields benefit or display.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same difference-color construction is repeated across humans, mobile creatures, and livestock, then closed by knowledge and awe. Botanical and mineral diversity in the focus ayah thus becomes one segment of a cross-domain classification of created difference with a cognitive and affective endpoint.

activation_trace.role: Mature botanical yield supplies the first living class in the extended sequence.
Solid mountain mass inserts the nonliving material domain between living classes.
Human beings add the social and embodied human domain to the color sequence.
Creatures moving on the ground broaden the sequence to mobile animal life.
Livestock supplies a familiar managed-animal class distinct from people and other moving creatures.
The repeated divergence branch carries the focus mechanism intact into the added life domains.
The repeated kind-by-color term makes the grammatical extension explicit.
Disclosed knowledge names the readerly competence elicited by the expanded diversity.
Awe supplies the response generated when difference is understood rather than merely viewed.

structural_cues: 35:28 repeats the focus phrase and uses an explicit comparison marker before its knowledge-and-awe conclusion.
The domain sequence runs fruit, mountain, human, other mobile creature, and livestock.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact grammatical repetition across five domains and then names knowledgeable awe; I infer a deliberate cross-domain lesson in differentiated created kinds. A live alternative is that the conclusion gathers all preceding signs broadly rather than color diversity in particular.

changed_reading.before: The focus ayah compares colorful fruit with colorful rock.
changed_reading.after: Fruit and mountain variation begin a continuous survey of difference across matter, human bodies, and animal life, intended to mature from observation into knowledgeable awe.

context_deltas.mechanism: One transmitted book reaches an expressly selected group, yet its bearers occupy three different trajectories: self-wronging, middle course, and precedence in good. This social mechanism activates the focus pattern of one source issuing in differentiated outcomes without collapsing those outcomes into equal value.

activation_trace.role: A common delivered source anchors the analogy's shared input.
Realized benefit lets fruit function as an outcome rather than only a botanical object.
Distinct paths provide the focus-side mechanism for divergent reception.
Transmission of book or knowledge as inheritance establishes one received source.
An organized written object identifies the common content inherited by all three groups.
Selection holds the recipient population constant before its internal divergence.
A middle course supplies one differentiated trajectory between extremes.
Advancing ahead supplies another trajectory and makes the outcomes evaluatively ordered.

structural_cues: 35:32 uses one inheritance event followed by a threefold repeated recipient partition.
The focus ayah likewise places plural differentiated results after a singular delivered source.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies one inherited book, one selected recipient set, and three paths; I infer an analogical mapping from one water and varied fruits to one guidance and varied embodied results. A live alternative is that the threefold taxonomy has no intended relation to the earlier natural mechanism.

changed_reading.before: One water producing varied fruits is only a natural-process observation.
changed_reading.after: The natural mechanism can also model differentiated reception: a common gift does not erase recipient-specific trajectories or their unequal value.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context pairs concealed and public action, joins deep knowledge with seeing, and names both the unseen and interiors from which acts issue. Focus colors are therefore legible surfaces but not exhaustive essences: they invite inference while preserving a hidden causal depth unavailable to appearance alone.

activation_trace.role: Visible apprehension anchors the public face of the sign.
A thing's visible figure makes surface presence explicit without defining its interior.
Concealment in the interior supplies the hidden side of enacted response.
Manifest action supplies the publicly visible side paired with concealment.
Knowledge of inner reality exceeds what surface inspection alone can recover.
Insight joins seeing to penetration beyond the visible face.
What is screened from eyes establishes a real domain beyond visible color.
An interior source from which actions issue supplies causal depth beneath appearance.

structural_cues: 35:29 balances concealed and public giving within one practice.
35:31 and 35:38 couple seeing with deep knowledge, then move explicitly from cosmic hiddenness to interiors.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies paired hidden/public action and knowledge of unseen interiors; I infer that the colors in 35:27 function as indices rather than complete disclosures. A live alternative is that they are signs of agency without carrying information about hidden composition or motive.

changed_reading.before: The visible palette gives the full content of the observation.
changed_reading.after: Color is a readable surface effect that points toward generative depth while warning that visible classification never exhausts interior reality.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context insists on an enduring followed way that admits neither replacement nor redirection. Set against repeated variation and acquired color in the focus ayah, this distinguishes variable outputs from variable law: plurality is generated within stable process rather than by breakdown of order.

activation_trace.role: Divergent paths supply the changing outputs that require an account of underlying order.
Taking on new color makes state variation explicit.
A continuously followed way supplies the stable rule beneath changing outcomes.
Alteration of form, explicitly negated here, distinguishes lawful variation from replacement of the governing pattern.
Change from one state to another, also negated of the pattern, sharpens invariance beneath diverse states.

structural_cues: 35:43 repeats the governing pattern three times and pairs two emphatic negations of its replacement or redirection.
35:27 repeats difference and color while preserving one ordered descent-to-yield construction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an invariant historical pattern and focus-level variable outputs; I infer the broader distinction between stable generative order and diverse results. A live alternative is that 35:43 concerns moral-historical consequence only and should not be generalized to the natural process.

changed_reading.before: Color diversity looks like free-standing variability.
changed_reading.after: The plurality of colors becomes evidence that a stable process can repeatedly generate non-identical outcomes without itself being replaced or redirected.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because speech and action are not water, but it remains anchored in the focus descent verb and the context's exact counter-movements of ascent and lifting. Render it only as a vertical analogy of gift and response, not as a hydraulic cycle or a claim that 35:27 directly denotes worship.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Word 5 establishes downward delivery, while the focus process converts that gift into visible yield.

activation_trace.role: Delivery downward supplies the first vector of the proposed vertical exchange.
Upward movement of good speech supplies the reverse vector.
Raising converts righteous action into the enabling lift of the returning movement.

changed_reading.before: The focus ayah depicts a one-way downward supply chain.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, descent and fruiting form the giving half of a vertical circuit whose human answer is good speech ascending through enacted good.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus forms ordinarily mark synchronic difference, while the later occurrence denotes successors. It remains anchored in the shared source root, its available succession branches, and the focus's visible lines; render it as a temporal echo that permits cohorts or layers, not as a claim about scientific geology or the sole sense of the focus wording.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The repeated difference root at words 12 and 19 stands beside the mountain lines at word 16.

activation_trace.role: Separate paths preserve the ordinary synchronic divergence of the focus wording.
Alternation in sequence activates a latent temporal dimension within the same focus root.
Visible extended lines give temporal succession a possible layered material trace.
One cohort replacing and succeeding another makes the temporal branch explicit in context.

changed_reading.before: Different colors coexist at one observational moment.
changed_reading.after: A secondary live reading hears difference diachronically as well: fruits recur in cohorts and mountain lines can appear as accumulated layers of non-identical states.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading is surprising because rock bands are not literally a book. It remains anchored in visible lines, reflective seeing, nearby written and inscribed media, and illumination; render the mountains as script-like or readable only by analogy, never as an identification with revelation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Word 16 supplies visible lines in the mountain, and word 2 asks for reflective seeing of them.

activation_trace.role: Extended visible lines provide the graphic surface for the script analogy.
Reflective judgment turns looking at lines into an act of reading significance.
Ordered written marks supply the comparison domain for the mountain's visible lines.
Illumination makes the comparison one of legibility rather than mere shape.
Inscription or writing reinforces the nearby graphic medium without erasing the domain boundary.

changed_reading.before: Mountain bands are visual geological decoration.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, their ordered lines become a readable natural surface whose significance is approached as one approaches illuminated writing.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The eschatological contrast is remote from botany, which makes it surprising, but the exact shared source root firmly anchors it. Render it as a contrast in enabled versus unavailable passage to the outside, not as an equation of fruit with punished persons.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Word 9 names divinely effected emergence through the supplied medium.

activation_trace.role: A concealed product is successfully brought into visibility by enabled agency.
The requested passage to an outside is voiced precisely where that exit is unavailable.
Promised intentional action states why the speakers seek a renewed opportunity to emerge.

changed_reading.before: Emergence is a neutral stage in natural growth.
changed_reading.after: The later denied plea makes focus emergence look like an enabled, timed passage granted by agency, not an automatic capacity possessed by whatever is enclosed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is branch-distant because the focus noun denotes mountain lines while the context adjective denotes new creation. It remains anchored in the same source root and in branches linking cutting, post-cut novelty, and visible lines; render it as a lexical resonance of discontinuity and renewal, not a geological chronology or a replacement for the ordinary band sense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Word 16 is the mountain-line term whose root also carries cutting and renewed state.

activation_trace.role: Visible tracks preserve the ordinary material anchor in the mountain.
Severance activates a boundary-making event behind the visible line.
Novelty after discontinuity supplies the contextual renewal pole of the resonance.
Fresh created existence makes the contextual newness generative rather than cosmetic.

changed_reading.before: The mountain lines are static bands.
changed_reading.after: A contained secondary reading lets each line register a boundary after which a distinct state appears, making banding a visual grammar of discontinuity and renewal.

strongest_changes: The water-to-fruit clause expanded from a simple fall-and-growth report into a governed release, transport, revival, and differentiated-yield pipeline.
The opening demand to see became an epistemic test because appearance can mislead, while the repeated color construction culminates in knowledge and awe.
Exact repetition in 35:28 extended fruit and mountain difference across human and animal life, making color a cross-domain classification rather than isolated scenery.
The invariant pattern in 35:43 distinguished stable generative order from the variable outputs displayed in 35:27.
summary.what_was_special: The trace retained both material mechanisms and form-distant activations: controlled hydrology, patterned rock, unequal media, differentiated social reception, hidden interiors, a non-dominant rain-as-marking mapping, and contained vertical, temporal, script-like, exit, and renewal resonances.
remaining_uncertainties: The focus ayah does not state that rain causes the mountain bands; their linkage may be analogical and visual only.
The knowledge-and-awe conclusion may gather the whole preceding discourse rather than attach narrowly to color diversity.
The social inheritance analogy is mechanistically coherent but remains a cross-domain inference rather than an explicit comparison.
The temporal, script-like, vertical, and discontinuity readings depend on distant branches and should remain exploratory.

baseline.text: Allah'ın gökten su indirdiğini görmedin mi? Onunla renkleri çeşitli ürünler çıkardık. Dağlarda da beyaz, kırmızı, çeşitli renklerde şeritler ve kapkara olanlar vardır.

findings.text: Tek bir suyun farklı renk ve ürünler çıkarması, ortak kaynağın alıcılardaki gizli farklılıkları etkinleştirerek çoğulluk ürettiğini gösterir.
Dağ şeritleri, yalnız renk değil, kesilme ve yenilenme süreçlerinin bıraktığı görünür oluşum izleri olarak okunur.
Dağlardaki çizgiler, farklı oluşum dönemlerini maddede saklayan okunabilir bir kayıt görünümü de kazanır.
Yoğun siyahlık, yalnız renk yokluğu değil, büyük bir maddi kütle ve koyu bir iç çekirdek izlenimi verir.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Perception depends on whether light, sound, and life can cross a receptive threshold.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The contrasts become mechanisms of access: inward insight, blinding noon, induced hearing, and the grave as a sealed or sunken enclosure.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Eye, blindness, and inward sight
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: The eye receives a visible object, but full perception requires an inward faculty that can be present or absent independently of eyesight.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: eyesight (quranic:root_000121:B001/m01); insight of the heart (quranic:root_000121:B002/m01); loss of eyesight (quranic:root_001049:B001/m01); blindness of heart and judgment (quranic:root_001049:B002/m01); sight by eye or insight (quranic:root_000531:B001/m01); disclosure to the knower (quranic:root_001040:B001/m01)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Physical sight and inward discernment form separate but coordinated operations. The contrast at 35:19 therefore reaches beyond ocular capacity to the heart's ability to recognize what vision presents.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Truth is stabilized, transmitted, and tested through durable marks, ordered following, and public evidence.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Textuality includes editing, enrollment, and the bodily or procedural act of following, not only a finished book.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Following, dispatch, and delivery
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A predecessor is followed, a messenger is dispatched with carried speech, and the message is delivered to its destination.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: following in sequence (quranic:root_000186:B001/m01); sending or dispatch (quranic:root_000563:B001/m01); messenger and carried message (quranic:root_000563:B002/m01); descent or delivery of a thing (quranic:root_001492:B002/m01)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The lexical following in 35:29 materializes recitation as ordered attachment to a prior text. Dispatch and delivery extend that order into a communication route with sender, carrier, and recipient.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Need is answered through capacity, circulating trade, expenditure, and a return that is complete rather than depleted.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Spiritual dependence is rendered as appetite, market liquidity, bid competition, payroll, and settlement of an account.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Need, appetite, and sufficiency
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Material lack or an unbounded appetite creates dependence, while sufficient means allow an agent to stand without that need.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: material need and poverty (quranic:root_001169:B002/m01); appetite-driven poverty of the self (quranic:root_001169:B004/m01); wealth and independence (quranic:root_001110:B001/m01); sufficiency that stands in for another resource (quranic:root_001110:B002/m01); fortune or worldly means (quranic:root_000227:B002/m01)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Poverty is split into external lack and internal appetite, while wealth is split into possession and functional sufficiency. The contrast clarifies that abundance can fail to remove dependence when desire itself remains unbounded.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Color is a surface state that can differentiate matter, disguise its substrate, or register bodily disorder.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Color extends from classification into metallurgy and pathology, where a coating can counterfeit value and redness or whiteness can mark swelling and disease.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: White, red, black, and composite complexion
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Distinct visible hues are distributed across objects and combined into each entity's outward complexion.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: whiteness (quranic:root_000168:B001/m01); redness (quranic:root_000356:B001/m01); blackness opposed to white (quranic:root_000757:B001/m01); composite visible complexion (quranic:root_001387:B001/m01)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 35:27 `بِيضٌ/حُمْرٌ/سُودٌ/أَلْوَٰنُ` (ب ي ض/ح م ر/س و د/ل و ن); 35:28 `أَلْوَٰنُ` (ل و ن).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The motifs form a compact chromatic system: opposed base hues and the composite complexion through which an entity is seen. The system can classify fruit, stone, and living bodies without treating them as one material.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Color is a surface state that can differentiate matter, disguise its substrate, or register bodily disorder.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Color extends from classification into metallurgy and pathology, where a coating can counterfeit value and redness or whiteness can mark swelling and disease.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Precious surface and deceptive coating
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A base object is coated with precious metal and thereby made to present the visual value of a different substrate.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: gold as metal (quranic:root_000522:B001/m01); gilding or gold wash (quranic:root_000522:B002/m01); coating base metal with gold or silver (quranic:root_001458:B005/m01); precious gold or silver vessel (quranic:root_001077:B018/m01); patterned or dyed cloth that misrepresents its condition (quranic:root_001290:B009/m01)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Color can be manufactured as a persuasive surface. Gilding and patterned cloth expose the ambiguity between genuine material and a coating that borrows another material's appearance.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Color is a surface state that can differentiate matter, disguise its substrate, or register bodily disorder.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Color extends from classification into metallurgy and pathology, where a coating can counterfeit value and redness or whiteness can mark swelling and disease.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Color as swelling and disease
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A bodily or animal disorder emerges as a visible swelling whose white or red coloration marks pathology.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: white swelling in a horse or limb (quranic:root_000168:B012/m01); reddened swelling (quranic:root_000356:B006/m01); animal disease from surfeit (quranic:root_000356:B007/m01); ulcer or swelling emerging from the body (quranic:root_000400:B004/m01)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 35:27 `بِيضٌ/حُمْرٌ/أَخْرَجْ` (ب ي ض/ح م ر/خ ر ج).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The same hue terms that pattern mountains can diagnose a body. Color becomes an index of an underlying process, with emergence and swelling explaining how an interior disorder becomes externally legible.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Hard terrain is made useful by finding, cutting, lining, and retaining water-bearing cavities.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The mountain image resolves into a practical excavation scene with resistant rock, a lined well, a hidden depression, and emerging water.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Hard face and resistant excavation
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: An excavator encounters a raised hard mass, tests its surface, and must work against compact material that stops digging.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: raised hard mass (quranic:root_000217:B001/m01); hardness that stops excavation (quranic:root_000217:B005/m01); flat hard ground-face (quranic:root_000227:B007/m01); compact earth and cohesion (quranic:root_001008:B007/m01); broad smooth ground (quranic:root_000766:B009/m01); smoothed and leveled surface (quranic:root_000434:B008/m01)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Mountain hardness is not a generic solidity motif; it is resistance encountered by a digging operation. Flatness, cohesion, and the stoppage of excavation define the worked face of the terrain.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Hard terrain is made useful by finding, cutting, lining, and retaining water-bearing cavities.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The mountain image resolves into a practical excavation scene with resistant rock, a lined well, a hidden depression, and emerging water.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Lined well and retained water
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A depression is identified, excavated or lined, and made stable enough to collect and release water.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: well in pasture ground (quranic:root_000227:B010/m01); stone lining and strengthening of a well (quranic:root_000621:B001/m01); rock cavity retaining rainwater (quranic:root_000434:B011/m01); water emerging and increasing (quranic:root_001458:B002/m01); hole or water outlet in ground (quranic:root_001169:B005/m01); hidden depression (quranic:root_001117:B002/m01)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Water usefulness depends on constructed containment. The hidden or natural depression becomes a reliable well only when its walls and substrate are made firm enough to hold what emerges.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Delivered water activates a productive cycle in which plants emerge, fruit matures, and lost growth returns.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The cycle includes irrigation technique, recurrent vegetation after loss, flower emergence, and fruit as both produce and beneficial outcome.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Water delivered from above
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Water descends, is conveyed by pouring or irrigation, and becomes a life-bearing resource.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: downward arrival (quranic:root_001492:B001/m01); delivery or bringing down (quranic:root_001492:B002/m01); water as substance (quranic:root_001458:B001/m01); irrigation by pouring water (quranic:root_001458:B003/m01); sky or overhead source (quranic:root_000745:B004/m01); rain as provision (quranic:root_000560:B003/m01)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 35:27 `أَنزَلَ/مَآءً/سَّمَآءِ` (ن ز ل/م و ه/س م و); 35:29 `رَزَقْ` (ر ز ق).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Descent is separated from delivery and from the substance delivered. This gives the rain scene a precise source-route-resource structure that can support the subsequent emergence of fruit.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Delivered water activates a productive cycle in which plants emerge, fruit matures, and lost growth returns.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The cycle includes irrigation technique, recurrent vegetation after loss, flower emergence, and fruit as both produce and beneficial outcome.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Fruit, returning growth, and increase
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Plants flower and bear mature fruit; after prior loss or dryness, replacement growth returns and increases.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: mature fruit (quranic:root_000205:B001/m01); beneficial result as fruit (quranic:root_000205:B003/m01); replacement vegetation after loss (quranic:root_000433:B010/m01); tender shoot emergence (quranic:root_000810:B004/m01); blossom of a tree (quranic:root_001564:B004/m01); increase and growth (quranic:root_000657:B001/m01)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Yield is both a botanical product and a generated benefit, but those senses remain distinct within the same productive sequence. Returning growth makes increase a renewal after loss rather than mere accumulation.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, görmeyi hem gözle algılama hem de gözün işlevine benzetilen içsel kavrayış olarak kuruyor. Doğrudan göz tanıklığı bu çekirdeğin duyusal gerçekleşimidir; zihinsel görüş, uyku düşü ve başkalarına görünme amacı bu dalın dışında kalır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dalın çekirdeği görsel ya da içsel algıdır; belirli söz öbekleri ve bakma çabası ayrı kullanımlar olarak tutulur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın görme çekirdeği ile doğrudan göz tanıklığını ve görmeye çalışma bildiren bağlı kullanımlar birbirine karıştırılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi gözle ya da göz işlevi gören içsel kavrayışla algılamaktır. Gözün eriştiği yerde doğrudan görme, bu anlamın duyusal ve tanıklığa dayalı gerçekleşimidir.

facets.statement: Görülebilir bir şeyi gözle veya benzer bir içsel kavrayışla algılama.
Bir şeyi gözün eriştiği yerde doğrudan ve tanık olarak görme.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çizgisi, gözle görmeyi temel alır ve bazı anlatımlarda bu algıyı içsel kavrayışa kadar genişletir; doğrudan göz tanıklığı özellikle belirtilir.
